integrity: The mathematical claim is supported by an explicit exhaustive verifier and a structural rooted-tree reduction. Literature comparisons distinguish the previously known optimum vector from the new exact count and cycle distribution. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact census is for the specified labelled Hachimori eight-vertex triangulation only; no equality of counts across other minimal dunce-hat combinatorial types is asserted. The exhaustive computation is deterministic but not a proof-assistant certificate. An older 2003 source gives the optimum vector but only month-level publication metadata was verified, so the day-level date field uses the earliest exact public timestamp verified without inventing a day.
title: Exact optimal discrete-gradient census for the minimal eight-vertex dunce hat
